tasks.title: Add the open error codes and the header parser for JPEG, PNG/APNG, GIF and the refused formats
tasks.dod: Vitest proves sniffImageHeader returns format, size, animated and orientation for JPEG/PNG/APNG/GIF fixtures, the named UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT for SVG/BMP/ICO/TIFF/RAW/PSD and NOT_AN_IMAGE/UNREADABLE for junk and truncated bytes, never throwing; result.ts carries all eight new codes

tasks.title: Extend the header parser to WebP, AVIF and HEIC/HEIF and add the property/fuzz test
tasks.dod: Vitest proves sniffImageHeader reads WebP (VP8/VP8L/VP8X), AVIF/AVIS and HEIC sizes and animation, returns UNREADABLE for missing ispe or oversized boxes, and the fuzz suite over truncated and mutated samples never throws or hangs

tasks.title: Implement the open policy: size ceiling, Downscale-limit target size, reduction steps and drop-candidate order
tasks.dod: Vitest proves checkOpenPolicy refuses above 100 MP with both sizes in MP, targetSize maps 6000x4000 to 4096x2731 and keeps <=4096 unchanged with a >=1 px short side, reductionSteps never exceed 16384 px, and orderDropCandidates keeps browser order

tasks.title: Implement the pure View model (Fit, zoom steps, clamp, zoom-at-point, pan clamp, auto-fit) and the Work revision rule
tasks.dod: Vitest proves fitZoom never exceeds 1, zoom clamps to [min(Fit,10%), 800%], steps follow ZOOM_STEPS, zoomAt keeps the pointer point fixed, pan stops at edges and centres fitting axes, resize honours autoFit, and hasUnsavedEdits flips only via withEdit

tasks.title: Build the decode worker pipeline and the main-thread decodeImage client with supersede and error mapping
tasks.dod: Vitest proves decodeImage terminates a superseded worker and resolves it as Superseded, terminates on result, passes typed {code, details} errors through, and maps NotReadable/NotFound/Security errors to FILE_NOT_PERMITTED; the worker runs header -> policy -> decode -> stepwise downscale -> transfer

tasks.title: Add the worker's orientation and HEIC capability probes and the EXIF-orientation fallback
tasks.dod: Vitest proves the 8-orientation transform table and that probe results from the first worker are cached and passed to later workers; HEIC decode failure maps to UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT where the probe says unsupported and DECODE_FAILED where it says supported

tasks.title: Add the platform intake: window drop guard, files from a DataTransfer, and the single-file picker
tasks.dod: Vitest (happy-dom) proves installDropGuard prevents the default on dragover and drop, filesFromDataTransfer returns only files in browser order with a non-file count, and pickImageFile resolves null on cancel

tasks.title: Build the WebGL2 preview renderer: mipmapped Original texture, View transform uniform, DPR sizing, draw-on-change
tasks.dod: Vitest proves viewToTransform maps Fit, 100%, zoom-at-point and pan correctly and the renderer schedules exactly one rAF per change and none when idle; setOriginal uploads the new texture before deleting the old one and marks imgly:first-frame

tasks.title: Handle WebGL context loss: restore from the kept bitmap within the deadline, else report DISPLAY_LOST
tasks.dod: Vitest with fake timers proves the renderer goes restoring -> ready when restored within 5000 ms (re-uploading from the kept bitmap), restoring -> lost after the deadline or on rebuild failure, and ignores late restores

tasks.title: Add the notice queue and the shared UI primitives Spinner, Toast, ToastStack, Dialog and CanvasMessage
tasks.dod: Vitest proves the notice queue shows every notice of one open together, auto-dismisses info after 6000 ms and keeps failures until dismissed, and Dialog traps focus, cancels on Esc and returns focus; the five primitives are registered in docs/design-system.md

tasks.title: Implement the editor store's open and replace rule: latest-open-wins, confirm on Unsaved edits, cancel, and View actions
tasks.dod: Vitest with a fake decoder proves the store replaces without confirmation when there are no Unsaved edits, enters confirming when there are, cancel keeps Work/View and closes the pending bitmap, refusals change nothing, and only the latest open can replace

tasks.title: Add drop sequencing, the messages catalog and the notices raised by each open
tasks.dod: Vitest proves every AppError and info notice renders the exact catalog copy, drops are tried in browser order until one opens with a files-ignored notice, an all-failed drop shows the first image file's reason or the AC-04 notice, and notices are pushed only after a replace

tasks.title: Build the editor shell and SCR-01: top bar, empty canvas with Open image, drop overlay, loading spinner and toast boundary
tasks.dod: Playwright e2e on three engines proves the empty editor shows one primary Open image action and the drop hint, a dropped non-image shows 'Only image files can be opened.' without navigation, and the drop overlay appears on drag-enter; component tests cover SCR-01 states

tasks.title: Build SCR-02's PreviewCanvas with the renderer, Fit on open, and the zoom and pan gestures
tasks.dod: Playwright e2e proves an opened image appears at Fit (never above 100%), Ctrl/Cmd+wheel zooms toward the pointer without page zoom, wheel/Shift+wheel/drag pan and stop at the edge, resize re-fits only until a manual zoom, and Chromium shows 1 image px per device px at 100%

tasks.title: Build the status bar: Original dimensions readout, zoom controls with the live zoom level, and the zoom shortcuts
tasks.dod: Playwright e2e and component tests prove the readout shows the Original's dimensions while the Work is open (4096 x 2731 px for 6000x4000), the zoom buttons and Shift+1/Shift+0/+/- step through fixed levels within [min(Fit,10%), 800%] with a live percentage, and Ctrl/Cmd +/-/0 are never intercepted

tasks.title: Build SCR-03, the replace confirmation dialog, on the store's confirming phase
tasks.dod: Playwright e2e on three engines proves that opening an image over a Work with test-prepared Unsaved edits shows the SCR-03 dialog with focus on Cancel, Cancel/Esc keep the Work id, revision and View with no notices, and Replace shows the new image at Fit followed by its notices

tasks.title: Add the start-up capability gate and the blocking screens SCR-04, SCR-05 plus SCR-02's restoring state
tasks.dod: Playwright e2e proves a browser without WebGL2 shows the SCR-04 message with no Open image and a drop that opens nothing without navigation, a WEBGL_lose_context loss restored in time redraws at the same View, and an unrestored loss shows SCR-05 after 5000 ms

tasks.title: Precache the decode worker for offline opens, run e2e on three engines in CI, and record the widened rules
tasks.dod: CI runs the functional e2e suite on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, and offline.spec.ts proves an image opens to a fitted Preview with the dimensions readout after going offline and reloading; ESLint forbids vue/pinia/features imports in src/infra; architecture-map records both decision overrides

tasks.title: Add the cross-engine reference-set e2e: honest outcome per file, 8 of 8 orientations, Work integrity on every refusal
tasks.dod: Playwright on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit opens every reference fixture with and without a prepared Work and asserts a correct Preview or the exact catalog message, 8/8 upright orientations, TOO_LARGE for the bomb before decoding, and unchanged Work id/revision on every refusal

tasks.title: Add the @perf suite: time to first Preview, long tasks, zoom/pan frame rate and memory after 10 opens
tasks.dod: The @perf Playwright suite, run by hand on the reference machine, reports p95 time to first Preview for the 12 MP and 48 MP JPEG, the longest long task, zoom/pan fps and the memory ratio after 10 opens against the spec §6 targets, and the dev bitmap counter returns to one retained Original
